tasks.title: Understanding Unicode
inputs: Python chr/ord and representations of strings

subtasks.c: Describe behavior when this character occurs inside text.

deliverables: One-sentence response for each subquestion

tasks.title: Unicode Encodings
inputs: The handout's intentionally incorrect per-byte UTF-8 decoder

subtasks.a: Explain reasons to prefer UTF-8 over UTF-16/UTF-32 for this tokenizer.
subtasks.b: Give a failing input and explain the supplied decoder's error.
subtasks.c: Give a two-byte sequence that does not decode to Unicode characters and explain.

deliverables: Short explanations and the requested counterexamples, not merely output screenshots

tasks.title: BPE Tokenizer Training
inputs: vocab_size: int (maximum final size, including base bytes and special tokens)
deliverables: Training function returning vocab: dict[int, bytes]
merges: list[tuple[bytes, bytes]] in creation order
contract_notes: Use §2.4 training rules and pre-tokenization boundaries.
Special tokens are hard boundaries and excluded from merge counts.
Frequency ties prefer the lexicographically greater pair of byte strings.

tasks.title: BPE Training on TinyStories

subtasks.a: Train and serialize vocabulary/merges; report elapsed time, memory, longest token and interpretation.
subtasks.b: Profile and identify the most time-consuming part.

deliverables: Serialized vocabulary and merges
One-to-two sentence responses to a and b

tasks.title: BPE Training on OpenWebText

subtasks.a: Train and serialize vocabulary/merges; interpret the longest token.
subtasks.b: Compare tokenizer learned from TinyStories and OpenWebText.

deliverables: Serialized vocabulary and merges
One-to-two sentence responses to a and b

tasks.title: Implementing the tokenizer
inputs: Input text, iterable of strings, or token IDs
deliverables: Tokenizer class
Constructor and from_files
encode, lazy encode_iterable and decode
contract_notes: Special tokens must remain atomic and may need adding to vocabulary.
Apply trained merges without crossing pre-token boundaries.
Stream boundaries must not alter tokenization semantics.
Malformed decoded UTF-8 uses replacement character U+FFFD.

tasks.title: Experiments with tokenizers

subtasks.a: Compute each tokenizer's compression ratio in bytes/token.
subtasks.b: Apply TinyStories tokenizer to OWT sample and compare.
subtasks.c: Measure throughput and estimate time for 825 GB Pile; downloading Pile is not required.
subtasks.d: Encode train/development datasets, serialize token arrays and explain suitability of uint16.

deliverables: Short answers for a–d
Encoded TinyStories and OWT train/development token datasets

tasks.title: Implementing the linear module
deliverables: Custom nn.Module with nn.Parameter weight stored as W (out_features, in_features), without bias
Initialization from §3.3.1

tasks.title: Implement the embedding module
deliverables: Custom nn.Module embedding lookup
Parameter matrix (vocab_size, d_model), initialized as in §3.3.1

tasks.title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization
deliverables: RMSNorm module preserving activation shape
Float32 normalization computation followed by restoration of input dtype

tasks.title: Implement the position-wise feed-forward network
inputs: d_ff approximately (8/3)*d_model, rounded to a multiple of 64
deliverables: SwiGLU feed-forward network using SiLU and gating
contract_notes: torch.sigmoid is explicitly permitted for numerical stability.

tasks.title: Implement RoPE
deliverables: RotaryPositionalEmbedding with shape-preserving forward and arbitrary leading batch dimensions

tasks.title: Implement softmax
deliverables: Numerically stable softmax retaining input shape

tasks.title: Implement scaled dot-product attention
inputs: Q, K, V with arbitrary leading batch-like dimensions
deliverables: Scaled dot-product attention output with final value dimension d_v
contract_notes: True means permitted attention; masked-out probabilities are zero.

tasks.title: Implement causal multi-head self-attention
inputs: Input activations, position information and weights
deliverables: Causal multi-head self-attention module
d_k=d_v=d_model/num_heads; RoPE on Q/K, not V

tasks.title: Implement the Transformer block
deliverables: Pre-norm block combining attention and SwiGLU sublayers with residual connections

tasks.title: Implementing the Transformer LM
inputs: Block configuration plus vocab_size, context_length, num_layers
deliverables: Transformer LM: embedding, blocks, final normalization and LM head
Unnormalized logits over vocabulary

tasks.title: Transformer LM resource accounting
inputs: Assignment architecture with GPT-2-XL-shaped dimensions: vocab 50257, context 1024, layers 48, d_model 1600, heads 25, d_ff 4288

subtasks.a: Count trainable parameters and memory to load them.
subtasks.b: List forward matrix multiplies and total FLOPs for one context-length input.
subtasks.d: Repeat proportional accounting for GPT-2 small/medium/large shaped configurations and interpret trend.
subtasks.e: Increase XL context length to 16384; explain total and proportional FLOPs changes.

deliverables: Parameter/memory result, matrix multiplication inventory, component FLOPs and short interpretations

tasks.title: Implement cross-entropy
inputs: Logits with vocabulary on final axis
deliverables: Stable mean cross-entropy over arbitrary leading batch dimensions

tasks.title: Tuning the learning rate
deliverables: One-to-two sentence response describing observed loss decrease or divergence
tasks.distinction: Not the full LM hyperparameter search task named learning_rate.

tasks.title: Implement AdamW
inputs: Learning rate, beta1/beta2, epsilon, weight decay
deliverables: torch.optim.Optimizer subclass maintaining per-parameter moments/state and matching fixed handout update order

tasks.title: Resource accounting for training with AdamW
inputs: Paper problem's 80 GB and H100 assumptions

subtasks.a: Derive separate parameter, activation, gradient and optimizer-state memory expressions and their total.
subtasks.b: Instantiate GPT-2-XL-shaped case as a*batch_size+b and find maximum batch fitting 80 GB.
subtasks.c: Derive FLOPs for one AdamW step.
subtasks.d: Estimate training hours for 400K steps, batch 1024, single H100 at given 495 TFLOP/s and 50% MFU, with backward twice forward FLOPs.

deliverables: Expressions and brief justifications; numerical instantiation where requested
tasks.distinction: H100 is the accounting question's assumption, not the 2026 experimental hardware reference.

tasks.title: Implement cosine learning rate schedule with warmup
inputs: t, alpha_max, alpha_min, warmup iterations T_w, final annealing iteration T_c
deliverables: Learning-rate function covering warmup, cosine and post-annealing regions

tasks.title: Implement gradient clipping
deliverables: In-place clipping of gradients using a norm over all parameters

tasks.title: Implement data loading
deliverables: Sampled input and next-token-target tensors, each (batch_size, context_length), on requested device
contract_notes: §5.1 requires memory-mapped loading for large stored arrays and matching dtype/file format.

tasks.title: Implement model checkpointing
inputs: Output/input path or binary file-like object
deliverables: save_checkpoint
load_checkpoint restoring model/optimizer and returning saved iteration

tasks.title: Put it together
deliverables: Training script with configurable hyperparameters
Memory-efficient train/validation data loading
Checkpoint serialization
Periodic training and validation logging

acceptance.note: Handout does not name a single official unit test proving completion of the whole script.

tasks.title: Decoding
deliverables: Prompt completion until EOS or maximum length
Temperature-scaled sampling
Nucleus/top-p sampling

acceptance.note: Generation behavior must be checked; this task alone does not establish learned-model fluency.

tasks.title: Experiment logging
inputs: Training/evaluation metrics, gradient step counts and wall-clock times
deliverables: Experiment tracking infrastructure
Document recording tried experiments and corresponding curves
tasks.working_order_note: Integrate before starting long baseline/ablation runs, despite its later handout section.

tasks.title: Tune the learning rate

subtasks.a: Sweep learning rates, report final losses/divergence and curves, explain search; produce target-validation-loss model.
subtasks.b: Investigate stability boundary with increasing learning rates, at least one divergent run, and analysis of relation to convergence.

deliverables: Learning curves, search strategy and stability analysis
Model satisfying the explicitly selected route's validation-loss target

tasks.title: Batch size variations
inputs: Batch sizes from 1 to GPU memory limit, with intermediates including 64 and 128
deliverables: Learning curves for different batches
Re-tuned learning rates if necessary
Discussion of observed training behavior

tasks.title: Generate text
deliverables: At least 256 generated tokens or until the first <|endoftext|>
Brief fluency commentary and at least two quality-affecting factors

tasks.title: Remove RMSNorm and train
inputs: Baseline model with all RMSNorms removed
Previous optimal learning rate and lower learning rates
deliverables: Learning curve after removal and curve at best learning rate
Commentary on RMSNorm's impact

tasks.title: Implement post-norm and train
deliverables: Learning curve comparing post-norm with pre-norm

tasks.title: Implement NoPE
inputs: Variant with position embedding information removed
deliverables: Learning curve comparing RoPE and NoPE

tasks.title: SwiGLU vs. SiLU
inputs: Ungated SiLU FFN with d_ff=4*d_model to approximately match parameters
deliverables: Learning curves comparing approximately parameter-matched networks
Discussion of findings

tasks.title: Experiment on OWT
inputs: Same model architecture and total training iterations as TinyStories
deliverables: OWT learning curve and interpretation of loss differences from TinyStories
Generated text in TinyStories output format and discussion of fluency/data difficulty
